verdict.rationale: BILL's S&E API docs say you can set up virtual cards alongside budgets and users, and the product page says its cards are controlled per transaction. Separately, the AP side can pay connected vendors by virtual card. None of this shows a card being locked to one merchant or vendor, so the isolation part of the story is unproven. Missing for 10: evidence of vendor- or merchant-locked virtual cards, per-card limits for SaaS subscriptions, linking procurement purchase orders to card issuance, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
